description: Public, unauthenticated Hermes manual download acceptance samples. Each request object can be used directly as an API request body. Some protocols do not yet have drivers; expected describes the current behavior explicitly.

tasks.purpose: Verify the HTTP protocol entry point, regular file downloads, and custom filenames.
Verify HTTPS and a single-file download that does not trigger segmentation.
Verify HTTPS Range segmentation, progress, and merging.
Verify large-file downloads, pause, resume, persisted progress, and the segment limit.
Verify that the current HTTP driver saves an m3u8 URL only as a playlist and does not trigger HLS media segment downloads.

expected.note: The output file should begin with #EXTM3U.

tasks.purpose: Provide a real VOD media playlist with relative TS segment URLs for a future HLS driver; currently only the manifest text is saved.

expected.note: The manifest contains relative paths to .ts VOD segments; an HLS driver should parse and download them once implemented.

tasks.purpose: Verify a DASH manifest URL; currently only the XML is saved, without downloading audio/video Representation segments.
Verify a regular HTTP download of a .torrent metadata file; it must not be mistaken for a downloaded torrent payload.

expected.note: The primary file described by this metadata is Sintel.mp4 (129241752 bytes); the current implementation does not connect to peers, trackers, or DHT.

tasks.purpose: Verify that the current HTTP URL creation endpoint does not incorrectly accept a magnet URI as a downloadable URL.

expected.reason: The current create_by_url endpoint accepts only URLs with a host, and Hermes has no registered BitTorrent/magnet ProtocolDriver.
